video:video.video:title: Tejas Singh: A Life of Crime
video:video.video:description: Tejas Singh sings A Life of Crime and plays guitar. He builds familiar songs with a loop pedal, and if you'd like to hear his originals, just let us know.

video:video.video:title: Tejas Singh live: acoustic singer and guitarist for private parties and weddings
video:video.video:description: This is Tejas Singh's full live set at Sofar Sounds, singing and playing guitar. He can bring the same sound to your private party or wedding cocktail hour.

video:video.video:title: Acoustic singer-songwriter for a wedding cocktail hour: Tejas Singh, Thirty Days
video:video.video:description: Tejas Singh sings Thirty Days with his acoustic guitar at a wedding cocktail hour, and he plays soft enough that guests can keep talking.

video:video.video:title: Live band for a holiday party: Tejas Singh quartet
video:video.video:description: Tejas Singh's quartet plays a holiday party with a dance floor in front of the band. It's a great choice if you want people dancing at a party or reception.

video:video.video:title: Singer and guitarist for a private party: Tejas Singh live-looping No Woman No Cry
video:video.video:description: Tejas Singh builds No Woman No Cry from the ground up with live looping. He's one musician with a loop pedal, recording each part as he plays it.

video:video.video:title: Jazz duo for a cocktail hour: Autumn Leaves on guitar and upright bass
video:video.video:description: Here's the jazz duo playing Autumn Leaves on guitar and upright bass, at a volume that suits a cocktail hour. Book the duo for jazz standards as guests arrive.

video:video.video:title: Jazz trio for a cocktail hour: Sunny
video:video.video:description: A jazz trio plays Sunny on guitar, upright bass and drums, with brushes to keep the volume down. You can book the trio for a cocktail hour or a dinner.

video:video.video:title: Flamenco trio for a private dinner: Dirty Flamenco, live
video:video.video:description: Dirty Flamenco plays traditional flamenco and rumba at a private dinner. The trio is flamenco guitar, bass and cajón (a wooden box drum).

video:video.video:title: Flamenco guitar for a cocktail hour: tangos, Dirty Flamenco
video:video.video:description: Dirty Flamenco plays tangos, a quick, bright style of traditional flamenco, at a cocktail hour, with the volume low enough for guests to keep talking.

video:video.video:title: Flamenco guitar for a garden party: Bart's rumba, Dirty Flamenco
video:video.video:description: Dirty Flamenco plays Bart's rumba at a garden party, and they can bring the volume down so your guests can keep talking.

video:video.video:title: Flamenco trio for a private party: rumba, Dirty Flamenco
video:video.video:description: The three musicians in Dirty Flamenco play a rumba on guitar, bass and percussion at a private party.

video:video.video:title: Spanish guitar for a dinner party: farruca, Dirty Flamenco
video:video.video:description: A farruca on solo Spanish guitar, played live. It's a traditional style of flamenco, and Dirty Flamenco's guitarist can play it at your dinner party.

video:video.video:title: Spanish guitar for a private party: the Sabicas verdiales
video:video.video:description: A short piece by Sabicas on solo Spanish guitar, played live. If you're planning a private party, you can book Dirty Flamenco's guitarist on his own.

video:video.video:title: Spanish guitar for a wedding ceremony: Can't Help Falling in Love
video:video.video:description: Can't Help Falling in Love on solo Spanish guitar, played live. It's a popular wedding processional, and Dirty Flamenco's guitarist would love to play it.

video:video.video:title: Spanish guitar for a wedding ceremony: Malagueña, Dirty Flamenco
video:video.video:description: Gary Meyers plays a Malagueña on solo Spanish guitar. He's the guitarist in Dirty Flamenco, and you can book him on his own for a wedding ceremony.

video:video.video:title: Three Spanish guitars for a corporate event: Entre dos Aguas
video:video.video:description: Three flamenco guitarists take turns on Entre dos Aguas. Dirty Flamenco can play as three guitars, and it makes a great feature at a corporate event.

video:video.video:title: Dirty Flamenco, live
video:video.video:description: Here's Dirty Flamenco playing live at a private event, with flamenco guitar, bass and percussion. They're one of the few flamenco groups in Colorado.

video:video.video:title: Tony Medina as a duo: Going Down, the Freddie King standard
video:video.video:description: Tony Medina plays the Freddie King blues standard Going Down as a duo. He can play these songs on his own or with a bigger band.

video:video.video:title: Tony Medina as a duo: Don't Drink the Water, a Dave Matthews Band cover
video:video.video:description: Here's Tony Medina as a duo, playing Don't Drink the Water by the Dave Matthews Band. He can also play solo, or bring a band of up to four.

video:video.video:title: Classic rock covers for an office party: Drive, Tony Medina
video:video.video:description: Here's Tony Medina at an office party, playing Drive, the Cars song. He can play solo, or bring a band of up to four if you want people dancing.

video:video.video:title: Singer and guitarist for welcome drinks: Tony Medina's song Headline
video:video.video:description: Tony Medina sings and plays guitar on Headline, one of his own songs. He mixes originals like this one in with his covers.

video:video.video:title: Tony Medina live: blues and rock voice and guitar for private events in Denver
video:video.video:description: Tony Medina sings Purple Rain with his acoustic guitar. You can book him in Denver for a milestone birthday, an office party or a rehearsal dinner.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt acoustic: If You Were Near
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt plays his song If You Were Near on acoustic guitar in a Denver studio. This is what he sounds like solo, and your guests can easily talk over it.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt covers Blackbird by The Beatles
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt plays an acoustic cover of Blackbird by The Beatles. He leads with his own songs, and he's happy to mix in covers like this one if you ask.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt covers Willie Nelson: Mammas Don't Let Your Babies Grow Up To Be Cowboys
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt recorded this Willie Nelson song in the studio with a band behind him. If you'd like covers at your event, just let us know.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt as a trio: Heirloom Winnebago
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt plays his song Heirloom Winnebago with lead guitar and bass at an album release show in Denver. The trio gives you a fuller sound without drums.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt and his band live: Stuck Inside
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt and his band play Stuck Inside, one of his own songs, live in Denver. Alex Dezen of The Damnwells called this song equally whimsical and profound.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt live: an original singer-songwriter on voice and acoustic guitar, for private events in Denver
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt sings his own song Hope For Better Things with his acoustic guitar. If you're planning a ceremony or a retreat, he can bring this sound to you.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt solo at a listening venue: Standing In The Shadow Of The Moon
video:video.video:description: Here's René Moffatt on his own with an acoustic guitar, singing his song Standing In The Shadow Of The Moon live at a Colorado listening venue in February 2026.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt live: Goodnight, Texas
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt sings his song Goodnight, Texas with his acoustic guitar on stage at a Denver club in March 2026.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt and his band live: Calendar Year
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows, his four-piece band, play his song Calendar Year on stage at a Denver club. This is a great size for a summer party.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows at the Underground Music Showcase: Calendar Year
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt's full band plays his song Calendar Year at the Underground Music Showcase in Denver. This is the band he can bring when you want something bigger.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows at the Underground Music Showcase: Come Of Age
video:video.video:description: Here's René Moffatt's full band playing his song Come Of Age at the Underground Music Showcase in Denver. It's his folk and Americana sound with drums and bass.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows at the Underground Music Showcase: Drive, a Cars cover
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt and his full band cover Drive by The Cars at the Underground Music Showcase in Denver in summer 2026, in a set of his own songs.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows at the Underground Music Showcase: Goodnight, Texas
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows play his song Goodnight, Texas at the Underground Music Showcase in Denver. Book them for his own songs with a full band.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows at the Underground Music Showcase: Halfway Home
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows play his song Halfway Home at the Underground Music Showcase in Denver. You can book the same band for your event, too.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows at the Underground Music Showcase: Iron Gates Of Love
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt plays his song Iron Gates Of Love with his full band at the Underground Music Showcase in Denver. He's a lot louder here than in his solo sets.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows at the Underground Music Showcase: Stuck Inside
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt's full band, The Moonshadows, plays his song Stuck Inside at the Underground Music Showcase in Denver. For a dinner, he can also play solo.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows at the Underground Music Showcase: Waterfall
video:video.video:description: René Moffatt plays his song Waterfall with his full band at the Underground Music Showcase in Denver, and we can size the sound system to suit your venue.

video:video.video:title: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows at the Underground Music Showcase: What If I, What If You
video:video.video:description: Here's one of René Moffatt's own songs, What If I, What If You, played by his full band in summer 2026 at the Underground Music Showcase in Denver.

video:video.video:title: Solo jazz guitar for a cocktail hour: a blues in the style of Grant Green
video:video.video:description: This is a blues in the style of the jazz guitarist Grant Green, played on one guitar. One guitarist is a great choice for a cocktail hour or a dinner.

video:video.video:title: Solo jazz guitarist for a client dinner: Autumn Leaves
video:video.video:description: This is Autumn Leaves on one guitar, quiet enough to talk over. A solo guitarist works well for a smaller group and only needs a small corner of your venue.

video:video.video:title: Acoustic singer and guitarist for a private party: Mary Jane's Last Dance
video:video.video:description: One musician sings and plays Mary Jane's Last Dance, the Tom Petty song, at a private party. You can book a singer and guitarist for just an hour.

video:video.video:title: Solo jazz guitar for a holiday party: White Christmas
video:video.video:description: One jazz guitarist plays White Christmas here, at a volume that suits a holiday dinner. We can also play these songs as a trio with upright bass and drums.

video:video.video:title: String quartet for a gala or a wedding: Beethoven's Op. 18 No. 6, first two movements
video:video.video:description: A string quartet of two violins, viola and cello plays the first two movements of Beethoven's Op. 18 No. 6, and you can hear how full the sound gets.

video:video.video:title: Solo violin for a wedding ceremony: the Andante from Bach's Sonata No. 2
video:video.video:description: This is the Andante from Bach's second sonata for solo violin, played by one violinist. It's a lovely choice for the prelude or the processional at a wedding.

video:video.video:title: Solo violin: Paganini's Caprice No. 19
video:video.video:description: Here's Paganini's Caprice No. 19 on a single violin. Our string players can also play Bach at your wedding ceremony, or Coldplay arranged for strings.

video:video.video:title: Solo violin: the Allegro from Bach's Sonata No. 2
video:video.video:description: A violinist plays the Allegro from Bach's second sonata for solo violin. One violinist is a great choice for a wedding ceremony or a dinner.

video:video.video:title: Violin: the first movement of the Sibelius Violin Concerto
video:video.video:description: Here's the opening movement of the Sibelius Violin Concerto in D minor, a thirteen-minute concert piece played by a violinist from our string quartet.

video:video.video:title: Afro house DJ for an after-party: live DJ set
video:video.video:description: Here’s the DJ playing a live outdoor set. The DJ plays Afro house, deep house, amapiano, techno and electronic music, and can play live tabla on request.

video:video.video:title: Country band for a wedding: Fire and Fly, Meghan Clarisse
video:video.video:description: Here’s Meghan Clarisse and her band playing Fire and Fly, one of her own songs. She can also play solo, or as a duo with pedal steel or electric guitar.
